title: Swallowed by the City: How Annexation Grew Calgary
script: Bowness was once its own town. So was Forest Lawn. Calgary became a city in 1894 and kept moving its borders: the village of Rouleauville (Mission) in 1907, then a burst of annexations from 1956 to 1961 took the city from 40 to 151 square miles, Forest Lawn in 1961, Montgomery 1963, Bowness voted to join in 1963 and joined in 1964, then 2007 farmland from Rocky View.
